sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you register and book, we store your email, username, an optional profile photo, and details about your reservations (court, date, time, payment status).

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used solely to create and confirm reservations, sign you in, and show your booking history.

sections.heading: Payment processing
sections.body: Payments are processed by our payment provider (Stripe); we never store card numbers on our own servers — all sensitive payment details are entered directly on the provider's side.

sections.heading: Data storage and protection
sections.body: Data is stored in a secured Supabase database with restricted access and is deleted on the account owner's request.

sections.heading: Service description
sections.body: This service lets you view tennis court availability, create reservations, and pay for them online.

sections.heading: Booking and payment
sections.body: A reservation is held for a limited time pending payment; an unpaid reservation is automatically cancelled and the slot becomes available again.

sections.heading: User obligations
sections.body: Users agree to provide accurate information when registering and to cancel promptly any reservation they no longer plan to use.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is", without guarantees of continuous court availability or freedom from technical issues.

sections.heading: Cancellation terms
sections.body: A confirmed reservation can be cancelled from your account before the booked time begins.

sections.heading: Refund process
sections.body: Funds for a cancelled reservation are refunded to the original payment method within a few business days.

sections.heading: Cases where a refund isn't possible
sections.body: Refunds aren't issued for reservations whose time has already started or passed, or for unpaid (automatically cancelled) reservations.
